name: GrowerSettlementStatement
tagline: From weighbridge ticket to grower remittance – shrink, grades, freight, levies, advances, approval and payment runs in one app.
description: A complete grower-payment module for grain co-operatives, bulk handlers, packers and processors. It calculates paid tonnes after moisture shrink, grade premiums and discounts, screenings dockage, freight, levies, tax, advances and deductions for every load, groups loads into settlement statements per grower, controls approval with a limit and second approver, records payment runs and gives growers a portal view with a Query this statement action. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Moisture shrink, grade spreads and screenings dockage
Other deductions printed on the statement
One-click statements per grower with skip reasons
Payment run with batch reference and overdue flags
CSV export with the full calculation
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
